summary: Phase 3 LZT Vault comprehensive testing completed. All backend APIs (17/17 tests) and frontend features working correctly. Fixed 2 minor backend issues: route ordering for /favorites/sync and default_region not returned from cache.

minor.issue: Route was defined after /favorites/{item_id} causing 422 instead of 401 - FIXED
default_region not returned when serving cached data - FIXED

Valorant skins API returns 1287+ skins from valorant-api.com
Skins have uuid, displayName, displayIcon, tier, tierColor, chromas
Advanced filters accepted: rmin, rmax, valorant_smin, knife
Admin settings returns 401 for non-authenticated users
Favorites GET returns 401 for non-authenticated users
Favorites POST returns 401 for non-authenticated users
Favorites DELETE returns 401 for non-authenticated users
Favorites sync returns 401 for non-authenticated users
Auth me returns 401 for non-authenticated users
Single item endpoint returns commission-applied price
Pagination works correctly (different items on page 1 vs 2)
API health check returns ok status

Only Valorant and League of Legends category tabs shown
Product cards show dynamic titles (Region|Rank|Skins format)
Commission prices displayed with strikethrough original price
Product cards show stat badges (LV, skin count, knife count)
Compare button on each card toggles selection
Compare bar appears at bottom when items selected (2/2 selected)
Compare modal opens with 2 items side-by-side showing all stats
Compare modal shows Price, Region, Rank, Level, Skins, Knives, VP, RP, Agents
Advanced filter sidebar present with rank range slider
Advanced filter sidebar has min skins slider
Advanced filter sidebar has knife toggle
Advanced filter sidebar has region dropdown
Clicking product card opens preview modal

Skin gallery shows weapon name, skin tier badge (Premium, Exclusive, etc.)
Preview modal shows commission-applied price with original strikethrough
Favorites heart button present on cards
LoL category tab switches correctly and shows accounts
Pagination works (next page button functional)
Admin dashboard shows 'Not authenticated' for non-logged users

critical_code_review_comments: Route ordering fixed: /favorites/sync now defined before /favorites/{item_id}
Cache response now includes default_region field
Skin gallery fetches from valorant-api.com with 24h cache
Compare feature allows side-by-side comparison of 2 accounts
test_credentials: No credentials needed - Google OAuth only. Admin requires first logged-in user.
seed_data_creation: No seed data needed - using real LZT Market API data
context_for_next_testing_agent: Phase 3 complete. Key features: 1) Only valorant+lol categories. 2) Commission 100% (price x2) with original_price preserved. 3) Dynamic card titles 'Region|Rank|Skins'. 4) Compare: select 2 cards, click Compare button in bottom bar. 5) Admin at /admin requires auth. 6) Skin gallery from valorant-api.com cached 24h. 7) Region filter is client-side. 8) Advanced filters: rmin/rmax, valorant_smin, knife. Fixed route ordering for /favorites/sync and default_region in cached responses.
mocked_api_note: NO MOCKED APIs - All data from real LZT Market API and valorant-api.com
